statusNarrative.review: The [fresh complete 0.47 review](docs/design/graphics-review-047.md) records **disposition: rebuild**. The deciding failure is focal art construction and finish: smooth armor, broad largely unmodulated garments, simplified anatomy and hand/boot transitions still read as assembled figures against richer stone scenery. Foreground paving boundaries, heavy repetitive wall courses, cutaway caps and overhead joins do not yet form a visually continuous inhabited space. Vowkeeper's committed sword cut is readable; Arcanist and Ranger rely too heavily on the hand/staff or bow gesture while coordinated hip and support effort remains slight at the ordinary camera scale. The review requires rebuilding focal character/material assets and room joins, strengthening ordinary-view cast and bow load/recovery, reducing measured rendering cost and obtaining actual Pixel 9 Pro Fold performance/input evidence. The technical foundation does not meet the promised visual ceiling.
statusNarrative.regression: The corrected local regression on Godot (4.7.2) records (34) suites, (3635) checks, zero failures and both server checks passing; the targeted correction checks total (404) passes. Local Android-release source/listing gates and (5) Python checks also pass. Gameplay CI [37204815585](https://github.com/Philmenting/Emberfall-Ashen-Veil/actions/runs/37204815585) independently passed the same (34 / 3635 / 0) regression and server checks on implementation source `2648672`. The [committed Android audit](docs/audit/2026-10-04/android-047/README.md) and [CI summary](docs/audit/2026-10-04/android-047/ci-summary.json) record all three exact-source runs as successful.
statusNarrative.android: Android build [37204844727](https://github.com/Philmenting/Emberfall-Ashen-Veil/actions/runs/37204844727) verified (0.47.0-beta.1 / 53), ARM64, API (36), APK signatures, AAB and (16 KB) ELF alignment. Runtime [37204846316](https://github.com/Philmenting/Emberfall-Ashen-Veil/actions/runs/37204846316) covered first fight, real reading pause and Back resume, the class relic, protected equipment, bag filters, combined oaths and cold restart. Its `graphics_only: true` probe rendered four regions in Balanced and Battery; AFK reconciliation was not rerun. Across (20) separately stepped combat samples per region, guardian bone index (3) changed its global pose (17/17/12/17) times, and each region yielded four distinct captured frames. These counts describe one sampled bone's pose changes. The root audit decoded all (28) native Android PNGs, inspected contact sets and full-size first-fight/reading images, and archived those two originals; no continuous Android playback or physical-phone test is claimed. Packages use CI-only ephemeral signing, with no established compatibility with other signing keys and no Google Play release.
statusNarrative.emulator: The [0.47 Android render report](docs/audit/2026-10-04/android-047/render-performance.json) uses an Android 16 Pixel 6-profile x86_64 emulator with swangle software rendering. Balanced regional median frame times are (1665.681–2143.638 ms), Battery (657.872–765.087 ms). This is a finite-rendering and advancing-animation gate; it does not establish the configured (60/30 FPS) caps, and different CI runs do not form a controlled performance comparison.
statusNarrative.controlledComparison: The separate [controlled same-host comparison](docs/audit/2026-10-04/render-047/README.md) ran one sequential 0.46 baseline / 0.47 candidate pair on Godot (4.7.2), Linux Xvfb and Mesa llvmpipe, with no competing renderer and (30) measured frames per region/mode. Median frame time increased in every case: Balanced **+47.0–81.3%**, Battery **+11.0–30.3%**, despite fewer or equal draw calls. This measured result supports no performance-gain claim. The [source manifest](docs/audit/2026-10-04/render-047/controlled-manifest.json) pins both revisions and report hashes. One frozen software-rendered workload does not measure sustained phone pacing, active game-loop CPU work or the benefit of skipping hidden previews. Physical-device FPS, heat, battery drain and touch response remain unmeasured.
statusNarrative.keep: Keep the shared adult Nyra face, original class and guardian identities, readable sword commitment, steady camera, complete warning footprints, restrained class-colored HUD and real reading pause. The final review confirms usable disabled Loot and command states, compact reading and honest performance labels. All (34) native stills are valid. This frozen 0.47 snapshot is a completed test result with a rebuild verdict, not visual or release acceptance; a further implementation pass is being prepared within the authorized overhaul. No later asset adoption is recorded here.
statusNarrative.package: The [corrected package](docs/previews/visible-combat/provenance.json) is complete: (34) original native PNGs, (4) fully decoded clips and one derived (24 s) side-by-side 0.46/0.47 attack comparison. All three affected sequences were fully recaptured after four renderer-only warmup frames and `frame_post_draw`; assertions preserve combat elapsed time. All ten affected starts are now populated and were opened, with reading frame (210), travel frame (449) and the comparison's first frame additionally checked by the root packaging pass. The manifest records the correction reason, replaced clip hashes and per-artifact fixture hashes. Its (151) current source hashes match; retained still-source hashes distinguish the two corrected capture fixtures, while runtime code and assets remain unchanged. The documenter independently checked current source and packaged artifact hashes, without rendering or decoding again. The initial [recapture report](docs/design/graphics-review-047-recapture.md) remains an unchanged historical evidence failure. The fresh reviewer inspected originals and sampled raw sequences, not continuous playback; the optional comparison and Android screenshots were not independently inspected in that review.

narrative.overview:
The user's complete graphics overhaul and explicit Diablo Immortal reference, recorded in [PRODUCT.md](PRODUCT.md) and the [0.47 direction contract](docs/design/graphics-direction-047.md), establish mature worn materials, spatial adult figures, a grounded isometric fight and localized light. Soot-dark iron, worn silver, oxblood cloth, wet slate and aged ivory surround original Emberfall characters and regional architecture. The reference sets direction and ambition; it does not establish commercial production equivalence. The superseded bright painterly illustration remains historical evidence. No successful concept seed, separate approved 0.47 composition or supplied QUALITY BAR card is inferred.

Live route-shaped paving, deep regional room modules and eleven lit skeletal figures carry the foreground. Five original generated distant plates provide camp and regional depth. Nyra retains the shared adult face, fitted eyes and lips, pale swept hair and saved equipment identity established in 0.45. The 0.47 construction pass reshapes bodies, hands, boots, armor and class garments around that identity; it adds no facial-expression or lip-sync rig. The face remains authored geometry with an original generated diffuse patch attached in rest space.

Attacks are central to this iteration: retargeted CC0 sword foundations and original native cast and bow phrases combine a planted support leg with an explicit free-foot step, load, contact and recovery at the existing simulation release. A room shot jointly fits pan and distance around stored actor and warning envelopes, then stays anchored through attacks and target changes. The compact native command dock, short state readouts and reading pause keep operational state available. Camp returns the hero to grouped workstations and a live rear corridor.
keyCharacteristics: Shared adult 3D Nyra identity across class, portrait, camp and combat.
Distinct sword, casting and bow phrases with authored support, step and return on native skeletal clips.
Continuous limbs, shaped hands and boots, class garments and mesh-attached material finish.
Live regional room modules, retained Archive basins and court geometry fitted around the authoritative route.
A steady room shot, complete danger footprints and a compact native command dock.
Scaled text, native touch sizing, safe-area offsets and a real reading pause.

rules.name: The Shared Geometry Rule
rules.body: Draw warnings from the same BossPatterns zones used for damage and avoidance; improve separation through material and outline treatment while preserving their active footprint.

rules.name: The Material Attachment Rule
rules.body: Sample character finish and Nyra's facial patch in immutable mesh rest coordinates; the material must stay attached to the animated surface.

rules.name: The Scaled Type Rule
rules.body: Route label and button sizes through `_scaled_font_size`: normal scale (1.0), compact scale (1.2), Large Text scale (at least 1.15, or 1.35 when compact), rounded to integers with a minimum (12). Paragraph helpers wrap; short state labels remain concise. Bundled fonts load offline.

rules.name: The Clear Passage Rule
rules.body: Derive tall dressing clearance and channel cuts from the generated floor and passage envelope; keep openings full height and remove whole obstructing props before static batching.

rules.name: The Steady Shot Rule
rules.body: Store the fitted room pan and distance through hits, casts and target changes; follow travel smoothly and widen only to preserve the complete reserved geometry.

rules.name: The Shared Face Rule
rules.body: Use the same live class/equipment geometry for portrait, camp and combat; inspect the lit head as well as its texture, and preserve the adult face through all three class views.

rules.name: The Combat Inspection Rule
rules.body: Show automatic skill state in words and cooldown tracks from the frozen expedition. Reading temporarily pauses live time: Close or Back restores the player's prior active/manual-pause intent, while Resume explicitly continues. Layout rebuilds and saves must preserve that intent.

rules.name: The Supported Action Rule
rules.body: Author leg, pelvis, chest, hand and weapon as one phrase at the actual release; coordinate the planted support foot and explicit free-foot curve through load, contact and recovery without changing the simulation clock.

rules.name: The Earned State Rule
rules.body: Camp seals appear only for saved guardian trophies. Class, equipment, guardian phase and warning cues come from real preparation or simulation state.

dos: **Do** use the authorized worn dark-fantasy material world, original regional construction and shared adult 3D Nyra identity.
**Do** carry native attack effort through the legs, hips, torso and weapon while preserving actual release timing and supported feet.
**Do** derive complete warning geometry, tall-dressing clearance and fluid cuts from the authoritative simulation and generated route.
**Do** keep camera, portrait, stage-light and material values aligned with their native source tokens.
**Do** use shared scaled-font, minimum-control and safe-area helpers while preserving the real reading-pause intent.
**Do** distinguish original geometry and generated diffuse assets from licensed external materials/animation, and label renderer fixtures and physical-device evidence by their actual source.
donts: **Don't** restore the superseded bright painterly world or replace live faces with painted portrait substitutes.
**Don't** place tall masonry or sliced props across the authoritative passage, or use visibility culling as its repair.
**Don't** add camera shake, alter simulation attack clocks for a visual phrase, or invent warning footprints that disagree with damage geometry.
**Don't** show unearned seals, imply a unique model for every item, or claim motion capture, facial-expression or lip-sync animation that is absent.
**Don't** reduce text or controls to force a compact layout, or infer visual approval, physical-device performance or release acceptance from renderer captures and test counts.
